FIX-B2_MOBILE_DIALOG_STACKING.evidence: Mobile 390x844 Landlord dialog: DialogContent width=370.5 (~95vw) OK. BUT inner .grid.grid-cols-1.sm:grid-cols-2.gap-4 has computed gridTemplateColumns='90.5px 214px' at 390px viewport — TWO columns active. Cognome input bbox x=35,y=311,w=91 and Nome x=141,y=311,w=214 → same Y (side-by-side) rather than stacked. Same issue in Tenant dialog: tenant-surname-input x=35,y=230,w=91 and tenant-name-input x=141,y=230,w=214 (side-by-side).
FIX-B2_MOBILE_DIALOG_STACKING.root_cause: Landlords.js / Tenants.js / Properties.js / Invoices.js wrap fields in <div className='grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4'> but full-width children (e.g. Indirizzo di Residenza, Dati Bancari, Firma, Note) use <div className='col-span-2'>. When a child specifies col-span-2 inside a grid-cols-1 container, CSS Grid auto-creates an implicit 2nd column to honor the span, making the entire grid effectively 2-column at all viewports. The 90.5px / 214px asymmetry is content-sized auto tracks rather than equal 1fr 1fr.
FIX-B2_MOBILE_DIALOG_STACKING.fix_suggestion: Change col-span-2 → 'col-span-1 sm:col-span-2' on children (Indirizzo, Dati Bancari, Firma, Note, etc.). Verify Landlords.js lines 239-240, 246+, Tenants.js similar lines, Properties.js, Invoices.js. This ensures mobile truly collapses to 1 column.

This will prevent implicit 2nd-column creation at <640px viewports and force true single-column stacking on mobile.

critical_code_review_comments: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 combined with col-span-2 children is a common Tailwind pitfall — always pair col-span-2 with a col-span-1 base class (or use the 'col-span-full' utility with an appropriate breakpoint prefix).
Consider extracting the form-grid pattern into a shared component (<ResponsiveFormGrid>) to avoid repeating the same grid/col-span combo across 4 files.

rca of the issue: FIX-B2 RCA — <div className='col-span-2'> on full-width inputs (Indirizzo di Residenza, Dati Bancari, Firma, Note) inside a grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 container causes CSS Grid's implicit track creation: when a child declares grid-column: span 2 in a 1-col grid, the browser auto-creates an extra column track to honor the span. This cascades down: all siblings then share 2 auto-sized columns (observed 90.5px / 214px based on content), making Cognome/Nome appear side-by-side at mobile viewports below the sm:640 breakpoint. Fix: either remove col-span-2 on mobile (use 'col-span-1 sm:col-span-2') or restructure the grid with explicit col-start/col-end.
